AJEX 2025 | The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) signaled the start of the AFP Joint Exercise “Dagit, Langit at Lupa” (AJEX “DAGITPA”) activities at the Laoag Sand Dunes, Barangay Navotas, Laoag City on November 4, 2025. The exercise brings together the Philippine Army, Navy, Marine Corps, and Air Force, with the participation of the Philippine Coast Guard and the Philippine National Police, to enhance interoperability and joint operational readiness.

The annual AJEX “DAGITPA” serves as a key component in the AFP’s implementation of the Comprehensive Archipelagic Defense Concept (CADC), aimed at strengthening joint defense capabilities across land, air, and maritime domains. Training activities will include airfield seizure, counter-landing live fire, amphibious operations, and land defense exercises in Northern Luzon—demonstrating the AFP’s commitment to securing the nation’s territorial integrity through unified and coordinated operations.

Photos from 503rd Infantry Brigade, 5th Infantry Division

data.text:
🇵🇭 Latest News on the Disaster in the Philippines

🔍 Key Developments

Typhoon Kalmaegi (locally named “Tino”) has ravaged the central Philippines, particularly the island of Cebu in the Visayas region. The storm triggered massive flooding and landslides. 

As of 5 November 2025, the death toll has risen to at least 66 people, with another 26 reported missing across the affected provinces. 

Among the fatalities were six military personnel whose helicopter crashed during a humanitarian mission in the province of Agusan del Sur on the island of Mindanao. 

Many residents were trapped on rooftops and upper floors as floodwaters overwhelmed houses and submerged vehicles. In some places in Cebu, ramps of water rose so fast that people had to escape to their roofs. 

The province of Cebu has declared a state of calamity to enable faster deployment of funds and aid. 

Over 387,000 people were evacuated ahead of the storm in regions like Visayas, southern Luzon and northern Mindanao. 

The storm is now moving toward the South China Sea and expected to impact parts of Vietnam and possibly Thailand. 

---

📝 Social‐Media Post (English & Hindi)

English Version

> 🌧️ Devastation in the Philippines – Typhoon Kalmaegi Hits Hard
The central Philippines reels from the impact of Typhoon Kalmaegi (Tino), which unleashed torrential rains, flash floods and deadly wind in the Visayas and Mindanao regions. At least 66 lives have been lost, with dozens missing and hundreds of thousands displaced.
A Philippine military helicopter crashed while on a relief mission, claiming six lives. Homes are destroyed, cars piled up, and entire communities are under water. The province of Cebu has declared a state of calamity as survivors try to rebuild from this tragedy.
As Kalmaegi moves toward Vietnam and Thailand, the urgency of global support and solidarity has never been greater.
💙 Let’s stand together, share verified help links and send relief to those affected.
#Philippines #TyphoonKalmaegi #DisasterRelief #CebuAid

हिंदी संस्करण

> 🌧️ फिलीपींस में तबाही – तूफ़ान कालमैगी का कहर
तड़के लगने वाले तूफ़ान कालमैगी (नाम “टिनो”) ने फिलीपींस के सेंट्रल इलाकों जैसे विसायस और मिंडानाओ में भारी बारिश, फ्लैश फ्लड और शक्तिशाली हवाओं के साथ कहर बरपाया है। अब तक 66 से अधिक लोगों की मौत हो चुकी है, दर्जनों लापता हैं और लाखों विस्थापित हो गए हैं।
एक राहत मिशन पर जा रही वायुसेना हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटनाग्रस्त हुई, जिसमें छह जवानों की जान गई। घर ध्वस्त, गाड़ियाँ बर्बाद, और सम्पूर्ण समुदाय जलमग्न। सीबू प्रान्त ने आपात स्थिति घोषित की है, ताकि राहत कार्य जल्दी शुरू हो सके।
कालमैगी अब वियतनाम व थाईलैंड की ओर बढ़ रहा है — वैश्विक समर्थन और एकजुटता की आवश्यकता आज पहले से बहुत अधिक है।
💙 आइए, verified राहत के लिंक साझा करें, सहायता भेजें और साथ खड़े हों।
#Philippines #TyphoonKalmaegi #राहतकार्य #सीबू
